content.short: The Seal Society Cardano NFT Project brings you! Seal Merch. A unique collection of CNFTs that are Redeemable for Merchandise.
content.description:
The Seal Society Cardano NFT Project brings you! Seal Merch. A unique collection of CNFTs that are Redeemable for Merchandise. Featuring items by The Seal Society and our Partners, this collection will be Cardano's go-to Merch Drop!

You will have the opportunity to mint an item you can wear in the real world!

This collection will also be verified on all secondary nft markets on Cardano. Burn your CNFT to redeem for your physical item.

Bringing Innovation to Cardano NFTs!
